articles.headline: Collin Dixon's 2 TD catches help Illinois become bowl eligible with 24-13 victory over Nebraska

article.story: Vanderbilt (3-5) at Mississippi State (4-4), Nov. 7 at 4:15 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Mississippi State by 2.5. Against the spread: Mississippi State 4-4, Vanderbilt 3-5. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats Mississippi State Offense Overall: 408.1 yards per game (51st in FBS) Passing: 246.5 yards per game (47th) Rushing: 161.6 yards per game (63rd) Scoring: 26.6 points per game (82nd) Mississippi State Defense Overall: 378 yards per game (91st in FBS) Passing: 261.5 yards per game (128th) Rushing: 116.5 yards per game (32nd) Scoring: 28.1 points per game (103rd) Vanderbilt Offense Overall: 342.9 yards per game (109th in FBS) Passing: 236.6 yards per game (59th) Rushing: 106.3 yards per game (129th) Scoring: 22.8 points per game (105th) Vanderbilt Defense Overall: 366.9 yards per game (75th in FBS) Passing: 217.3 yards per game (77th) Rushing: 149.6 yards per game (78th) Scoring: 30.3 points per game (113th) Vanderbilt is 114th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 43% of the time. Mississippi State ranks 62nd on offense, converting on 40.2% of third downs. Vanderbilt is 132nd in the FBS with a -8 turnover margin. Mississippi State is 117th in the FBS with 70.5 penalty yards per game. Team leaders Mississippi State Passing: Kamario Taylor, 1,460 yards, 17 TDs, 4 INTs, 65.4 completion percentage Rushing: Da'Marion Bothwell, 563 yards on 108 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Anthony Evans III, 666 yards on 56 catches, 5 TDs Vanderbilt Passing: Jared Curtis, 1,489 yards, 8 TDs, 8 INTs, 65.0 completion percentage Rushing: Sedrick Alexander, 274 yards on 64 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Junior Sherrill, 706 yards on 49 catches, 4 TDs Last game Mississippi State fell to Texas 31-3 on Oct. 31. A.J. Swann passed for 97 yards on 12-of-15 attempts (80.0%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. Bothwell carried the ball 17 times for 49 yards, adding three receptions for 13 yards. Marquis Johnson put up 61 yards on six catches. Vanderbilt lost 34-17 to Kentucky on Oct. 24. Curtis passed for 247 yards on 27-of-36 attempts (75.0%) with two touchdowns and one interception. Jamezell Lassiter carried the ball one time for six yards, adding one reception for two yards. Sherrill had eight receptions for 78 yards. Next game Mississippi State hosts Auburn on Nov. 14. Vanderbilt hosts No. 9 Alabama on Nov. 14.
